description: Waiting room UI: FoyerPage with Create Room button, new RoomPage showing room ID, invite URL with copy button, peer list, and connection status. Updates App.tsx routing to map /room/:roomId to RoomPage (waiting room) instead of TheatrePage. TheatrePage remains for later Theatre UI implementation at /theatre/:roomId or similar.
steps: 1. Update apps/web/src/pages/FoyerPage.tsx: Add Create Room button. On click, POST to /api/rooms (http://localhost:8787/api/rooms in dev), receive { roomId, inviteUrl }, navigate to /room/{roomId} using useNavigate() from react-router-dom.

2. Create apps/web/src/pages/RoomPage.tsx: Extract roomId from useParams(). Display room ID prominently. Show invite URL with a Copy button (navigator.clipboard.writeText). Show peer list from roomStore.peers with join times. Show connection status indicator (disconnected/connecting/connected/ready with color coding).

3. In RoomPage useEffect: Generate peerId (crypto.randomUUID()), get displayName from userPrefsStore or default to 'Watcher', create RoomClient instance, call connect(). Set up event listeners for 'peer-joined', 'peer-left', 'ready', 'connected'. Update roomStore on each event. Clean up on unmount (disconnect).

4. Add basic styling to RoomPage: Use CSS from apps/web/src/styles/global.css. Peer list as vertical list with names and join times. Connection status as colored badge (red=disconnected, yellow=connecting, green=ready). Invite URL in a readonly input with copy button.

5. Add i18n strings to apps/web/src/locales/en.json: 'create_room', 'room_id', 'invite_url', 'copy_invite', 'peers_in_room', 'connection_status', 'status_disconnected', 'status_connecting', 'status_connected', 'status_ready'. Placeholder strings for th.json and ml.json (copy English for now).

6. Update apps/web/src/App.tsx: /room/:roomId route already points to TheatrePage. DECISION: Keep TheatrePage for now as the full Theatre UI (playback). RoomPage is the waiting room. Add a new /waiting/:roomId route for RoomPage, OR rename the route. RESOLUTION: Change /room/:roomId to render RoomPage (waiting room). Add /theatre/:roomId route for TheatrePage (full playback UI, implemented in later milestones). Update FoyerPage to navigate to /room/:roomId.

7. Test: Click Create Room in FoyerPage, verify navigation to /room/:roomId. Verify room ID and invite URL displayed. Open invite URL in second tab, verify peer list shows 2 peers. Verify connection status shows 'ready' after key exchange. Click Copy button, verify clipboard contains invite URL.
acceptance_criteria: FoyerPage has Create Room button that calls POST /api/rooms and navigates to room page
RoomPage displays room ID, invite URL with working copy button, list of connected peers, and connection status
RoomPage automatically connects to room WebSocket on mount and performs E2EE key exchange
Peer list updates in real-time as peers join and leave
Connection status indicator shows progression: disconnected -> connecting -> connected -> ready
App.tsx routes /room/:roomId to RoomPage (waiting room) and /theatre/:roomId to TheatrePage (playback UI)
All UI text uses i18n translation keys
TypeScript compilation succeeds with no errors
verification: pnpm --filter @matinee/web dev and pnpm --filter @matinee/edge dev running simultaneously
Manual test: Open http://localhost:5173, click Create Room, verify room page loads with room ID and invite URL
Manual test: Copy invite URL, open in incognito/second browser, verify both tabs show 2 peers and 'ready' status
Manual test: Close one tab, verify other tab updates peer list to show 1 peer
findings: Implementation complete. All steps executed successfully: (1) Updated FoyerPage with Create Room button that calls POST /api/rooms and navigates to /room/:roomId. (2) Created RoomPage with room ID display, invite URL with copy button (using navigator.clipboard), peer list showing displayName and join times, and connection status indicator with color coding (red=disconnected, yellow=connecting, blue=connected, green=ready). (3) Integrated RoomClient in RoomPage useEffect: generates peerId with crypto.randomUUID(), gets displayName from userPrefsStore (defaults to 'Watcher'), creates RoomClient instance, calls connect(), sets up event listeners for 'connected', 'peer-joined', 'peer-left', 'ready', 'disconnected', and updates roomStore on events. Clean up on unmount with disconnect(). (4) Added styling to RoomPage using CSS variables from global.css: peer list as vertical list, connection status as colored badge, invite URL in readonly input with copy button. (5) Added i18n strings to en.json, th.json, ml.json: 'create_room', 'room_id', 'invite_url', 'copy_invite', 'peers_in_room', 'connection_status', 'status_disconnected', 'status_connecting', 'status_connected', 'status_ready' (placeholder English strings in th.json and ml.json). (6) Updated App.tsx routing: /room/:roomId now renders RoomPage (waiting room), added /theatre/:roomId route for TheatrePage (full playback UI for later milestones). (7) TypeScript compilation passed with no errors (pnpm --filter @matinee/web typecheck). Manual browser testing required to verify: Create Room navigation, room ID/invite URL display, copy button functionality, peer list updates, connection status progression, and two-tab WebSocket connection with E2EE key exchange.
